text: WELL IS DSI. NO HYDROCARBONS WERE ENCOUNTERED WHILE DRILLING TO SURFACE CASING SETTING DEPTH. WELL GA005 PBHL IS IN AC 0812 ON LEASE G24593, SURF LOC'N IS IN AC 0857 ON LEASE G17565. Batch set location is in surface location.

Attempted WL pack-off job failed to seal holes in tubing. Notified Cliff Delouche 12-28-07 on plans to set D-Plug below holes in tubing, bleed casing pressure down, and SI well (See Suppl Attachement). Updated Mark Malbrue, MMS Lafayette via telephone call on completed WL job on Jan 8, 2008.

10-3/4" and 24" casings will be cut and pulled at a minimum of 15' BML at time of platform removal.  An APM to cut and pull the casings a minimum of 15' BML will be submitted for approval.  MP311 Well No. A004 remains in TA status.

The cementing of well conductors and the pressure testing of casing annuli were not part of the well work procedures set
forth in the approved APM to PA dated October 6, 2009 and, as such, were not performed as part of the well PA operations.
The requested information should have been provided by the Operator of record when the well was Temporarily Abandoned
(TA) and should be contained in BSEE records.

Temporarily Abandoned. RPM 1 approved to cut the 26" and 20" casing ±10' above the mudline and leave the well in TA status. Once the platform is removed, a new permit will be submitted to externally cut and recover all casings from at least 15' BML.

Due to the 9-5/8-inch and 13-3/8-inch casings being grouted together, McMoRan could not remove the casing strings.  McMoRan received approval from Cliff DeLouche on 08/24/2010 to set a 9-5/8-inch CIBP at 259-ft MD (85-ft BML) + 50-ft of cement leaving TOC at 209-ft (35-ft BML).

Stone has successfully plugged & abandoned the EC 64, OCS-G-00089, Well #08.   Production on the #08 LS stopped in 1989 and on the SS in 1999.  The #08 was located on a platform that was severely damaged by Hurricane Ike.  P&A operations began on 11/14/2008 and ended on 12/09/2008.

Stone Energy successfully completed zone change operations on SS 112, OCS-00066, Well W-2.  The depleted "R-11" Sand was isolated by setting a plug @ 11150' MD and dumping ~60' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 11090'.  The "R-9" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 10906' - 10916' MD & 10856' - 10872' MD. Operations began on July 22, 2009, and ended on July 30, 2009.

Production tubing was cut and pulled from 9430'RKB 08/08/11. Production packer set @ 9380'RKB 08/09/11. New tubing with GLMs and SCSSV was run 08/10/11 - 08/11/11. Current wellbore schematic is attached.

We have encountered collapsed casing and are unable to 
complete the well as planned, so we would like to Abandon 
the current sands, set a CIBP above the casing calapse set
a Dry Hole Tree and evaluate the well for future utility.

Wellbore was sidetrack to a depth of 13,869' MD/ 12,372' TVD, no hydrocarbons were encountered.  A cement retainer was set at 8,850' MD / 7,659' TVD and a surface plug was set from 352 - 575' MD.  An APM will be submitted to perform permanent abandonment operations at a later date.

Wellbore permanently abandoned. P&A scope completed included subsea tree removal, upper completion removal, and 
installation of P&A plugs: deep cement Plugs 2/3, PWC Plug 4, bullhead squeeze Plug 5, shoe squeeze Plug 6, and Surface 
Cement Plug

Operations to temporarily abandon the well through the surface plug were completed on 07/25/2025.

eWell recognizes a TA date of 09/26/2013 due to previous zonal isolation operations & prevents updating the date. This
operation was to complete full TA through the surface plug

GA 272 A001: Current status: COM. TA was not complete due to problems with pulling the D plug stuck at 400'. A D Plug was set at 370' RKB and a BPV in tree on 4/24/15. Will require coil tubing to fish out the D plug at a later date. 
No changes to the wellbore other than a D plug being set and a BPV in the tree was added

The well was temporarily abandoned through the surface plug as of 02/07/2025; however, eWell recognizes the zonal isolation date as the temporary abandonment date from a previous EOR and cannot be changed.

Stone Energy has successfully completed a zone change to the L-22 Sand from the R-1 Sand. The operation entailed isolating the existing R-1 Sand by dumping a 50' cement plug on a TTBP set at 8069'MD. The L-22 Sand was then perforated from 8004'MD-8014'MD. Note: Decision was made to cease operations prior to running sand control due to difficulties running in & out of the wellbore w/ slickline & e-line. An informational e-mail was sent 06-13-2013 informing BSEE of this decision.

Stone successfully completed coil tubing clean out and thru-tubing gravel pack screen installation operations on SS 111, OCS-G-24924, Well A-7 in the "T-16" sand.  The thru-tubing gravel pack screen assy was installed at 15324' MD, across the existing "T-16" perfs, from 15388' - 15409' MD & 15436' to 15448' MD.  Operations began on March 29, 2009, and were completed on April 3, 2009.

EOR to convert well status from TA to PA for work performed from 12/18/2011 to 4/6/2012. Well has had no activity since TA operations in 2012 with lease expiration on 5/16/2018. Well is located directly under Spar within structure site clearance radius. Well is hybrid well, not subsea well. Site clearance will be performed with decommissioning of Spar.

Note: Operations to isolate the existing P-2-2 Sand perforations down hole were completed as of 04/18/2009; the well has not been truely temporarily abandoned, but the eWel system will not allow to leave the well in completed status due to entering in an isolation date.

The cementing of well conductors and the pressure testing of casing annuli were not part of the well work procedures set
forth in the approved APM to PA dated August 21, 2012 and, as such, were not performed as part of the well PA operations.
The requested information should have been provided by the Operator of record when the well was Temporarily Abandoned
(TA) and should be contained in BSEE records.
